evals.expected_output: Makes no Tableau calls. Asks which answer is wrong and what looks off if that isn't clear, then follows report-issue.md: quotes the answer, fills the email template with subject '[Tableau Skill] Wrong number: ...' and the technical details (source, query, filters, calls), offers an optional Share link, attaches the data as a CSV if any, shows the full email and sends it only after the user confirms.
